Overview

Sonsonate is a city in SO with a population of 110,000. A western city known for its sugar and coffee production, with a historic colonial center. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
